UCDH flextable theme

Source: R/theme_ucdh.R
theme_flextable_ucdh.Rd

Applies UC Davis Health styling to a flextable, using the UCDH navy and gold colors.

Usage

theme_flextable_ucdh(x)

Arguments

x

A flextable object.

Value

A flextable with UCDH styling applied.

References

UC Davis Health Graphic Standards: Colors # nolintr

Examples

flextable::flextable(head(iris)) |>
  theme_flextable_ucdh()
